relations.evidence:
Couchbase Server version 8.0

As of Couchbase Server version 8.0, you can choose to use the [bm25](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Okapi%5FBM25) algorithm instead of `tf-idf` for your Search index.

relations.subject: search:run-searches
relations.evidence: If one of your Search queries is a [Vector Search query](../vector-search/vector-search.md), the calculation changes to: hit_score = (query_1_boost * query_1_hit_score) + (knn_boost * knn_distance)
